evidence.snippet: To bridge this gap, we propose RandomBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate whether MLLMs can maintain distributionally neutral behavior when selecting among equivalent options.

claire_radar.motivation: Current evaluations for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) overwhelmingly focus on utility-driven objectives, leaving model behavior under logic-neutral scenarios largely underexplored.
claire_radar.name: RandomBench
claire_radar.oneLine: RandomBench evaluates whether multimodal LLMs maintain distributionally neutral behavior when selecting among equivalent options, providing metrics for entropy and distributional bias under explicit random instructions.
claire_radar.paperTitle: Evaluating Stochastic Collapse and Implicit Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models

source.title: Evaluating Stochastic Collapse and Implicit Bias in Multimodal Large Language Models

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Logic-neutral scenarios are underexplored in MLLM evaluation. RandomBench introduces a way to quantify stochastic collapse, a bias toward non-uniform choices that affects repetitive behavior and coverage, aiding design of more robust models.
